ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the diameter of $\odot O$ is 4, and $\angle ACB = 45^\circ$. What is the length of AB?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect OA and OB, as shown in the figure,\\
$\because$ $\angle AOB = 2\angle ACB = 2\times 45^\circ = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AOB$ is an isosceles right triangle,\\
$\therefore$ AB = $\sqrt{2}$OA = $2\sqrt{2}$.\\
Therefore, AB = \boxed{2\sqrt{2}}.
